controles.affirmation: En 2026, l'enveloppe PROMISE aux actionnaires a ete PORTEE A environ 55 Mds $ d'ici fin 2028.
controles.verbatim_source: In January 2026, we announced that we believed that our strategic plans would provide us with the CAPACITY to return approximately $55 billion to our shareholders, in the form of dividend payments and share repurchases, through the end of 2028... We cannot guarantee that our intended share repurchase program will be fully consummated or that it will enhance long-term stockholder value. (10-K FY2025, facteur de risque intitule 'There can be no assurance that our current or future share repurchase programs will be fully consummated or that we will continue to increase our dividend.')
controles.correction_proposee: Une capacite estimee n'est pas une promesse, et le document dit explicitement l'inverse d'une garantie. Par ailleurs 'portee a' suggere un relevement d'un montant anterieur : le 10-K n'en mentionne aucun, il s'agit d'une annonce initiale de janvier 2026. Formulation correcte : 'en janvier 2026, Verizon a annonce que ses plans strategiques lui donneraient selon elle la capacite de rendre environ 55 Mds $ a ses actionnaires d'ici fin 2028, sans garantie'.

controles.affirmation: Verizon decrit une concurrence par les prix agressive visant nommement ses clients et anticipe un ralentissement durable de la croissance du nombre de clients du secteur.
controles.verbatim_source: Competition remains intense as a result of various factors, including aggressive pricing, increased levels of promotions and service plan discounts, price locks and guarantees, and offerings that include additional bundled premium content or other perks, in some cases specifically targeting Verizon customers ; we expect the wireless industry's customer growth rate to continue to moderate over time in comparison to historical growth rates, leading to increased competition for customers.

controles.verbatim_source: Verizon operates in a highly regulated market.
